name: bnb
cmd: $PY -m pip install -q bitsandbytes && $PY -c 'import bitsandbytes as b; print("LAYA_BNB", b.__version__)'

name: trees
cmd: R=$(cd $S/../../.. && pwd); cd $R && git fetch -q origin laya-decision-best laya-decision-perf-rebased && for t in 't_pr 84db80f0a' 't_dh 12fcce54c' 't_ours origin/laya-decision-perf-rebased' 't_best origin/laya-decision-best' 't_bestns origin/laya-decision-best~1'; do set -- $t; [ -d $ROOT/$1 ] || git worktree add -q --detach $ROOT/$1 $2; echo "LAYA_TREE $1 $(git -C $ROOT/$1 log -1 --format='%h %s')"; done

name: verify_pytest_t_best
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_best && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -rfEs --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Warning|warnings.warn' | tail -60

name: verify_pytest_t_pr
cmd: cd $ROOT/t_pr && $PY -m pytest tests/test_decision_model.py -q -rfEs --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider 2>&1 | grep -vE 'Warning|warnings.warn' | tail -60
